rationale.regulatory-compliance: Embedded checks target GDPR, PCI DSS, licensing, privacy, and FTC obligations.
rationale.ai-review: Prompted AI inspects code and dependencies for legal and security risks.
rationale.oversight-scaling-inversion: AI development accelerates risk while affordable legal review cannot scale.
rationale.oversight-explanation: Dependency tables, data maps, and line references support human judgment.
rationale.agentic: AI agents build complete applications through multi-step development decisions.
rationale.non-developer: The focal creators are solo entrepreneurs lacking programming and legal expertise.
rationale.steering: Prompts also generate compliance documents and direct remediation changes.
rationale.risk-security: Security vulnerabilities receive focal analysis and automated mitigation guidance.
rationale.risk-ip: Open-source licensing and copyright risks receive dedicated checks and remediation.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Creators rely on confident AI decisions they lack expertise to evaluate.
